**Implementation note:** Max-Sharpe, min-variance and max-return weights.

## Description

Choose portfolio weights that maximize expected return for a target variance or maximize a risk-adjusted objective.

## Where it may fit

Strategic allocation when expected returns and covariance estimates are reasonably stable.

## Vehicles

Mutual funds, ETFs, multi-asset portfolios, institutional mandates.

## Required data

Expected returns, covariance matrix, asset constraints, risk-free rate, transaction costs and rebalancing schedule.

## Caveats

Expected returns are noisy; unconstrained solutions can be concentrated and unstable.
